wd.space: planets, the Moon, meteorites, the universe
wd.body: the brain, blood, the limits of the body

en.method_p: Every claim in a case carries one of five labels. A simulation never becomes a fact.

d.OBSERVED: Measured or recorded. Comes from data or direct observation.
d.ESTIMATE: Calculated from real values, with a stated margin.
d.SIMULATION: The output of a published numerical model, with its limits.
d.SCENARIO: A reasoned "what if", built on physics we know.
d.HYPOTHESIS: A plausible idea that science has not settled.
